title: Channel (channel.yaml)
description: A place a message can be sent: its format, its limits, what a recipient looks like and the pack handler that sends. Lives in packs/<pack>/channels/<name>/channel.yaml.

system.description: The comms system it sends through, e.g. comms

type.description: What a recipient is, e.g. email address, slack channel id

pattern.description: A regular expression the whole recipient must match

handler.description: An action name in the pack's actions: (comms.send-email)

conventions.description: Optional skill ref for the channel's conventions (bare = this pack)
